To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the performance of a web server architecture is highly sensitive to the workload mix and the number of database queries per web page, and the performance of a server architecture is not only determined by its own performance but is also affected by the performance of other architectures.

the performance of web servers can be greatly improved by (a) increasing the number of web servers, (b) increasing the number or speed of CPUs per server, and (c) increasing the number and size of disks per server.

the performance of a distributed web server architecture is significantly impacted by the type of workload, and that the performance of the web servers can be improved significantly by using a distributed web server with a load balancer.
In summary, our research is concerned with
performance evaluation of web server architectures under E-Commerce workload.
evaluating the performance of distributed web server architectures under E-Commerce workloads.
the performance evaluation of the web server architecture under realistic E-Commerce workloads.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
there is no single web server architecture that is the best under all circumstances.

the performance of web servers is highly workload dependent, and that the performance evaluation should be conducted based on a realistic workload that is representative of the application of interest.
the performance behaviors of the distributed web server architectures considered in this paper are quite different from those under a static web page workload.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have identified several key performance issues and provided some guidelines for designing and implementing high performance and reliable web server architectures for E-Commerce applications.
the performance of the web server architecture depends not only on the number of servers, but also on the number of database servers.
the performance evaluation of web server architectures is very important to the goal of high performance web server architectures.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a thorough understanding of web server performance under realistic E-Commerce workloads is essential to the development of high-performance and reliable web server architectures.
a web server architecture should be carefully designed and tuned for a specific workload to achieve the maximum performance.
it is important to understand the behavior and performance of the web servers under E-Commerce workloads.
